profile.headline: Fullstack Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a dedicated and self-driven person who strives to do the best job that I can. 

I try to make my career a part of my life instead of a job that I cannot wait to return home from at the end of the day. I endeavor to gain more technical skills while maintaining and developing my social and management skills at the workplace.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked as a back-end developer to help implement and design new data models for new features for an enterprise-to-enterprise social networking application for both web browsers and as a mobile wrapper; help implement a new REST API via JAX-WS for an enterprise-to-enterprise social networking mobile and web application; develop test suites using JMeter for the new REST API; helped integrate the enterprise-to-enterprise social networking application with an application gateway proxy; help design new data models for Content Server to better integrate with remote applications for social networking features.

positions.title: Java Development Analyst
positions.description: I helped: configure and diagnose a Content Management System; Create one design document detailing permissions and content architecture for the CMS; define the permissions structure in use for the CMS and Active Directory; design initial environment migration processes; write Groovy scripts to migrate assets and configurations not managed by CMS; coordinate efforts to migrate to build-out CMS in conjunction with other teams on the same project.

positions.title: Basic Income Tax Preparer
positions.description: Duties include: preparing income tax returns for customers, answering customer questions regarding their tax returns, served as assistant manager in absence of store owner.
